title: feat(nm2frm2mlxf): L-path cyclic-frame transport -e1 then -e3 at t+1 on three-axis far-face opposite seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: Bare L-path -e1 then -e3 on the three-axis far-face seed. Richest cross-reference set in the band (three not-leftover gates), and it states the far-face seed's one real structural effect: adding the (0,0,-1)/(0,1,-1) pair destroys the ORIGIN frame -- origin O collapses to {-e_2}, split fails -- which alone kills two of the four probes. Recomputed exact.
